lines.en: label beachmas8:
scene beachmastod1
: ...and that’s exactly why I think school should be done entirely online and that requesting our presence is a waste of both money and resources!
lines.zh: : ……所以这正是我认为学校应该完全改成线上授课的理由，要求我们到场既浪费钱又浪费资源！

lines.en: : Something wrong, Maya? You’ve been staring at the door for a good twenty seconds.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Maya？你已经盯着门看了整整二十秒了。

lines.en: scene beachmastod2
: Hm? What? No. I was just wondering when this stupid game is going to start since we’ve just been sitting in a circle for what feels like thirty minutes now.
lines.zh: : 嗯？什么？没有。我只是想知道这个蠢游戏到底什么时候开始，毕竟我们围成一圈坐着，感觉都坐了三十分钟了。

lines.en: : I’m with Maya! I would also like to get the game started!
lines.zh: : 我站 Maya！我也想早点开始游戏！

lines.en: scene beachmastod3
: As would I. I had an absolute blast the last time we played truth or dare and I can’t wait to see what wonders are in store this time.
lines.zh: : 我也是。上次玩真心话大冒险的时候我玩得特别开心，我已经等不及想看看这次会有什么精彩内容了。

lines.en: : And while I am very happy for you, Nodoka, I must remind you that you are forever banned from playing this game following your direct breach of both our trust and the rules last time.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，我为你感到高兴的同时，也必须提醒你——鉴于上次你直接违背了我们的信任和规则，你已经被永久禁止参与这个游戏了。

lines.en: : She can watch, though. Right? We can rob her of the privilege to play, but we can’t completely strip her of her freedom.
lines.zh: : 不过她可以看着，对吧？我们可以剥夺她玩的特权，但不能彻底剥夺她的自由。

lines.en: : You can all strip me in whichever ways you like. Though, I can’t guarantee I’d be the most fun person here to undress. I believe that role would have to go to-
lines.zh: : 你们想怎么剥我都行。不过我不保证我是这儿脱起来最有意思的人。我觉得那个角色得让给——

lines.en: : It’s going to be me, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 会是我，对吧？

lines.en: scene beachmastod4
: Touka.
lines.zh: : Touka。

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : That swimsuit does look a little tight. Would you mind if I just reached over and-
lines.zh: : 那件泳衣看着确实有点紧。你介意我伸手过去——

lines.en: : I would, actually. And very much so, at that.
lines.zh: : 我介意。而且是非常介意。

lines.en: : Hey, here’s a fun idea! How about we stop trying to strip Touka and indulge the wretched behaviors of the two most destructively horny girls on the planet and, instead, play some truth or dare!
lines.zh: : 嘿，我有个好主意！我们要不别再想着剥 Touka 的衣服、纵容这颗星球上最具破坏性的两个饥渴女孩的恶劣行径了，干脆开始玩真心话大冒险吧！

lines.en: : She says, despite being equally as wretched and horny.
lines.zh: : 她说这话，尽管她自己也一样恶劣又饥渴。

lines.en: if ayanelust10 == True:
: My bad. Sorry for being in love. Which is, crazily enough, a thing you will likely never feel!
lines.zh: : 我的错。抱歉我恋爱了。说来也怪，这大概是你们永远体会不到的东西！

lines.en: scene beachmastod5
: So, we already know that Nodoka is banned from participating in any way, but there are a few other rules we need to get out of the way first so things don’t become horrible out of nowhere!
lines.zh: : 那么，我们已经知道 Nodoka 被禁止以任何形式参与了，不过还得先把另外几条规矩说清楚，免得事情突然变得一团糟！

lines.en: : First and foremost, nothing sexual!
lines.zh: : 首先，也是最重要的——不许涉黄！

lines.en: : Laaaaame.
lines.zh: : 好——无聊。

lines.en: : You may dare another girl from this table to kiss you if you absolutely must. But that girl has the right to veto said kiss and, if she does, your dare has been forfeit and the next person goes.
lines.zh: : 如果你实在憋不住，可以指名在座某个女孩来亲你。但那个女孩有权否决这个吻，如果她否决了，你的大冒险就算作废，轮到下一个人。

lines.en: : There are no limits to what sorts of truths you can ask for though.
lines.zh: : 不过真心话问什么都没限制。

lines.en: : Hey, I have a question. Why did we mutate a timeless classic like truth or dare into something so family friendly that even my fucking sister would play it?
lines.zh: : 嘿，我有个问题。我们干嘛要把真心话大冒险这种永恒经典，改造成连我他妈妹妹都能玩的合家欢版本？

lines.en: : Because most of us here are wholesome and only you and Nodoka are degenerates.
lines.zh: : 因为这儿大多数人都是正经人，只有你和 Nodoka 是变态。

lines.en: : Ahem.
lines.zh: : 咳哼。

lines.en: : And Molly. But she’s a different type of degenerate.
lines.zh: : 还有 Molly。不过她是另一种类型的变态。

lines.en: scene beachmastod6
: ‘Tis the truth. I’m the brand of degenerate that you’d be okay with introducing to your mother so long as I was briefed on what not to say beforehand.
lines.zh: : 确实如此。我是那种你愿意介绍给你妈妈认识的变态——只要事先跟我交代清楚什么不能说就行。

lines.en: : And Kirin is the type who would fuck your dad.
lines.zh: : 而 Kirin 是那种会跟你爸上床的类型。

lines.en: : And I am the type who would fuck your mother. Now, who’s ready to play?
lines.zh: : 而我是那种会跟你妈上床的类型。好了，谁准备好开始了？

lines.en: : Not you! That’s for sure!
lines.zh: : 反正不包括你！这是肯定的！

lines.en: : Maya, you look a bit uncomfortable. Are you sure you do not want to leave the table before the game begins? No one will hold it against you.
lines.zh: : Maya，你看起来有点不自在。你确定不想在游戏开始前离开这张桌子吗？没人会怪你的。

lines.en: : Hey, yeah. Why are you here anyway?
lines.zh: : 对啊。说起来你为什么在这儿？

lines.en: : Because my other plans apparently fell through. Now, can we begin?
lines.zh: : 因为我原本的其他计划显然泡汤了。那么，我们可以开始了吗？

lines.en: : Go make them come true, then. Nothing’s going to happen by just sitting here.
lines.zh: : 那就去把它们变成现实啊。光坐在这儿什么都不会发生。

lines.en: : American movie star, Shia LaBeouf, always says to never let your dreams be dreams. I am with Ayane on this. And it is not only because we are both rich.
lines.zh: : 美国电影明星 Shia LaBeouf 总说，别让你的梦想只是梦想。这点我支持 Ayane。而且不光是因为我们俩都有钱。

lines.en: : Gee, thanks for reminding us. I almost forgot.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，谢谢你提醒我们。我差点忘了。

lines.en: : Kirin, you’re the most reckless person here. Why don’t you start?
lines.zh: : Kirin，你是这儿最不管不顾的人。你要不要先开始？

lines.en: scene beachmastod7
: Can someone else go first? I haven’t decided who I’m going to dare to kiss me yet.
lines.zh: : 能不能让别人先来？我还没决定要指名谁来亲我呢。

lines.en: : Perhaps it’s not too late to track down Noriko and have her join us for a round?
lines.zh: : 也许现在去找 Noriko 让她加入我们玩一轮还不算太晚？

lines.en: : Already tried. She won’t do it.
lines.zh: : 已经试过了。她不肯。

lines.en: : Oh my. Is it against the rules to share truths before they’re asked of you? Because I don’t believe that was something we were meant to hear.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。在别人问你之前就主动说出真心话，这算违反规则吗？因为我觉得那句话我们不该听见。

lines.en: scene beachmastod8
: You know what? I’ll save my dare until the second round.
lines.zh: : 这样吧，我把我的大冒险留到第二轮。

lines.en: : That is...assuming that person selects “dare,” correct? I’m not great at games that don’t involve controllers or touch pads.
lines.zh: : 那……前提是那个人选"大冒险"，对吧？我本来就不擅长那种不用手柄或触控板的游戏。

lines.en: : Correct. Kirin can’t just dare you to do something because she wants to. It has to be your choice.
lines.zh: : 没错。Kirin 不能因为自己想就随便指使你做什么。那必须是你自己的选择。

lines.en: : For the millionth time, lame. Ayane, truth or dare.
lines.zh: : 都说第一百万遍了，真无聊。Ayane，真心话还是大冒险。

lines.en: : Well, I definitely don’t want to kiss you so...truth.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我绝对不想亲你，所以……真心话。

lines.en: : Do you actually believe it’s realistic that you and Sensei are going to get married and start a family one day?
lines.zh: : 你真的觉得，你和老师有一天会结婚、组建家庭，这现实吗？

lines.en: scene beachmastod9
: That is...way tamer than I expected from you.
lines.zh: : 这……比我想象中的你温和太多了。

lines.en: : Also, I’ll answer for Ayane. She obviously doesn’t think that-
lines.zh: : 还有，我替 Ayane 回答吧。她显然不觉得——

lines.en: : Is that really all you want?
lines.zh: : 你就只想问这个？

lines.en: : Yeah. Is there a problem with that?
lines.zh: : 对。有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : I just figured it would be something more...Kirin.
lines.zh: : 我只是以为会问点更……Kirin 风格的东西。

lines.en: if ayanelust10 == False:
: Just answer the question, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 回答问题就行，Ayane。

lines.en: else:
: Just answer the fucking question before I ask you something else like when the last time you masturbated was.
lines.zh: : 赶紧他妈回答问题，不然我就要换一个问了，比如你上次自慰是什么时候。

lines.en: scene beachmastod10
: I...I don’t really know. If you asked me that question a year ago, I’d probably have an entirely different answer.
lines.zh: : 我……我真的不知道。如果一年前你问我这个问题，我大概会给出完全不同的答案。

lines.en: : But now, I barely even know if I’m going to make it to the end of each day. Let alone so far off into the future that I have a career and kids and...
lines.zh: : 可现在，我连自己能不能撑过每一天都不确定。更别提那么遥远的未来——有事业、有孩子，还有……

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : What I can say, though, is...if any of that ever does happen for me...I can’t imagine it being with anyone other than Sensei. So that’s all on him and whether or not that’s what he wants as well.
lines.zh: : 不过我能说的是……如果那些事真有发生在我身上的一天……我想象不出对象会是老师以外的人。所以这全看他，看他自己是不是也想要那样。

lines.en: : And also Ami because she makes the rules and you would need her blessing before doing anything as ridiculous as that.
lines.zh: : 还有 Ami，因为她定规矩，你要做那种荒唐事之前必须先得到她的同意。

lines.en: : You want to fuck your uncle. We know.
lines.zh: : 你想跟你舅舅上床。我们都懂。

lines.en: scene beachmastod11
: You said it. Not me.
lines.zh: : 这话是你说的，不是我。

lines.en: : Welp, I guess it’s my turn now, so...
lines.zh: : 好吧，看来现在轮到我了，那么……

lines.en: scene beachmastod12
: Maya...truth or dare?
lines.zh: : Maya……真心话还是大冒险？

lines.en: : Are you sure I’m the correct target?
lines.zh: : 你确定我是正确的对象吗？

lines.en: : Frankly, I can’t think of any better targets right now. And there are definitely some things I’d like to have you clear up.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我现在想不出更合适的对象了。而且我确实有几件事想让你说清楚。

lines.en: : I see. And what better setting to do that than a table full of our peers who will have no idea what we’re talking about?
lines.zh: : 我明白了。而且还有比在一桌同龄人面前更合适的场合吗？反正她们完全听不懂我们在说什么。

lines.en: : It’s true. I am quite lost right now.
lines.zh: : 确实。我现在完全是一头雾水。

lines.en: : Well...what’ll it be? Truth or-
lines.zh: : 那么……选什么？真心话还是——

lines.en: : Dare.
lines.zh: : 大冒险。

lines.en: : Oh. Oh, right. I just kind of assumed you were going to choose truth.
lines.zh: : 哦。哦，对。我只是下意识以为你会选真心话。

lines.en: : I am, unfortunately, in a position where I will never choose truth.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，我所处的立场让我永远都不会选真心话。

lines.en: : Welp, that helps narrow down my list for the next go around. Now to figure out who would rather kiss me between Molly and Maya.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这倒是帮我缩小了下一轮的名单范围。现在要搞清楚的是，Molly 和 Maya 之间谁更愿意亲我。

lines.en: : Umm...
: Come on, Ayane. There’s gotta be something you want out of Maya, right?
lines.zh: : 拜托，Ayane。你总有什么想让 Maya 做的事吧，对不对？

lines.en: : Maya...I...
lines.zh: : Maya……我……

lines.en: : I dare you to always look after Ami and Sensei if anything bad ever happens to me.
lines.zh: : 我要你保证：万一我遭遇什么不测，你要永远照顾 Ami 和老师。

lines.en: scene beachmastod13
: God! You’re all so fucking boring!
lines.zh: : 天啊！你们这群人真是无聊透顶！

lines.en: : To be fair, your question wasn’t much better.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，你问的问题也没好到哪儿去。

lines.en: : What do you mean “if something bad ever happens to you?” That’s really ominous and I don’t like it.
lines.zh: : "万一我遭遇什么不测"是什么意思？这也太不吉利了，我不喜欢。

lines.en: : It’s the request of a seasoned warrior at the end of her days who wants nothing more than to watch the kingdom she used to serve flourish.
lines.zh: : 这是一位身经百战的战士在生命尽头提出的请求，她唯一的愿望就是看着自己曾经效力的王国繁荣昌盛。

lines.en: : Maya is the next generation of the kingsguard and Ayane-
lines.zh: : Maya 就是下一代的王家护卫，而 Ayane——

lines.en: : Molly, shut up.
lines.zh: : Molly，闭嘴。

lines.en: : Ayane, if anything bad ever does happen to you, it will be precisely because of that destructive brand of selflessness.
lines.zh: : Ayane，如果真有什么坏事发生在你身上，那一定正是因为你那种毁人毁己的无私。

lines.en: : But regardless of that...I promise you, dare or not, that I will always protect the two of them no matter what happens.
lines.zh: : 但无论如何……我向你保证，不管是不是大冒险，无论发生什么，我都会永远保护他们两个。

lines.en: : You have my word.
lines.zh: : 这是我的承诺。

lines.en: : And my bow.
lines.zh: : 还有我的弓。

lines.en: : Molly, please shut up.
lines.zh: : Molly，拜托闭嘴。

lines.en: scene beachmastod14
: Why do I want to cry now?! And why are my friends so sweet when they’re not trying to get with my guardian?!
lines.zh: : 我怎么突然想哭了？！还有为什么我的朋友们在不想睡我监护人的时候能这么贴心？！

lines.en: : Let it be known that I, Molly MacCormack, have not attempted such a feat yet! At least not intentionally. But there was that one time in my room when-
lines.zh: : 在此郑重声明，我 Molly MacCormack 至今还没有尝试过这种壮举！至少不是故意的。不过有一次在我房间里，那时候——

lines.en: scene beachmastod15
: When what?
lines.zh: : 那时候怎么了？

lines.en: : Ah! Ami popped her racial ability that lets her get rid of all negative status effects once per day!
lines.zh: : 啊！Ami 发动了她的种族技能——每天一次，可以清除所有负面状态！

lines.en: : Wouldn’t that make you the only person at the table without that ability? Seeing as we’re all Japanese and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 那岂不是只有你这桌上的唯一一个人没有那个技能？毕竟我们都是日本人什么的。

lines.en: : What is the Irish racial ability?
lines.zh: : 爱尔兰人的种族技能是什么？

lines.en: : One that lets me dodge a targeted character ability once per day! Which I will use right now to stop myself from telling the rest of my embarrassing and shameful bedroom story!
lines.zh: : 每天一次，可以闪避一次单体指向技能！我现在就要用它来阻止自己继续讲完那段丢人现眼的卧室故事！

lines.en: : You absolutely will not-
lines.zh: : 你绝对不会——

lines.en: scene beachmastod16
: Molly. Truth or dare?
lines.zh: : Molly。真心话还是大冒险？

lines.en: : Oh, damn it, Maya! I was this close to figuring out if she needs to be added to my list or not!
lines.zh: : 哦，该死，Maya！我就差那么一点就能搞清楚她要不要被加进我的名单了！

lines.en: : You still have that thing?
lines.zh: : 你还留着那东西？

lines.en: : I will never get rid of it.
lines.zh: : 我永远都不会丢掉它。

lines.en: : The great and powerful Emerald Guardian is no stranger to risk...so the only option for me to choose is dare!
lines.zh: : 伟大而强大的翡翠守护者从不惧怕风险……所以我唯一能选的就是大冒险！

lines.en: : Excellent. I dare you to never tell anyone about any strange or embarrassing stories involving you or Sensei ever again as I thoroughly enjoy having an appetite and do not want it permanently ruined.
lines.zh: : 很好。我要你从此再也不跟任何人讲任何关于你或者老师的奇怪又丢人的故事，毕竟我很享受自己还有胃口这件事，不想让它被永久毁掉。

lines.en: : You realize that can just be bypassed the next time someone uses a truth command on her, right?
lines.zh: : 你该知道下次有人对她用"真心话指令"就能绕过去吧？

lines.en: : Every second I can buy is worth a thousand truths.
lines.zh: : 我能争取到的每一秒，都抵得上一千个真相。

lines.en: : A Thousand Truths sounds like a good guild name. Or an album title for a V-Kei band if you add a few more broody adjectives to the mix.
lines.zh: : "一千个真相"听着像个不错的公会名。要是再加几个阴郁的形容词，也挺像视觉系乐队专辑名的。

lines.en: : Like “A Thousand Bloody Screaming Truths in the Dead of the Night” or “A Thousand Angels Screaming Truths in...Blood.”
lines.zh: : 比如《深夜里一千个血色尖叫的真相》，或者《……血中一千个尖叫天使的真相》。

lines.en: : Or something.
lines.zh: : 之类的吧。

lines.en: : I also dare you to never speak again.
lines.zh: : 我还要你从此别再说话。

lines.en: scene beachmastod17
: You really do sound like the Herald of the Adolescents at times, you know.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，你有时候说话真的像那个"青春使者"。

lines.en: : Heheh...isn’t it great? It’s like I have an extra Sensei around whenever the first one forgets he’s supposed to love me every hour of every day.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……是不是很棒？就好像我身边多了一个老师，以防第一个老师忘了他应该每时每刻都爱我。

lines.en: : I have no clue what you’re talking about. But it appears that my time has expired so, please. Proceed.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道你在说什么。不过看来我的时间到了，那么，请继续。

lines.en: : Then...in that case...
lines.zh: : 那么……既然如此……

lines.en: scene beachmastod18
: Touka!
lines.zh: : Touka！

lines.en: : Present!
: Truth or dare? Choose your destiny.
lines.zh: : 真心话还是大冒险？选择你的命运吧。

lines.en: : Truth!
lines.zh: : 真心话！

lines.en: : But only because I know your degeneracy is nothing but a false label that others have plastered on you due to countless misunderstandings and I would like to give you a chance to prove your wholesomeness.
lines.zh: : 但这只是因为我知道，你身上"变态"的标签不过是别人因为无数误解给你贴上的虚假称号，我想给你一个证明自己清白正经的机会。

lines.en: : Gah! Thank you so much for your sweet and honeyed words!
lines.zh: : 啊！非常感谢你这番甜言蜜语！

lines.en: : NOW FORGIVE ME AS I LAY WASTE TO THEM! MWAHAHAHAH!
lines.zh: : 现在请原谅我，我要把它们统统摧毁！哇哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Um...I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你说什么？

lines.en: : Favorite sex position! What is it?!
lines.zh: : 最喜欢的性爱体位！是什么？！

lines.en: scene beachmastod19
: Excuse me?!
lines.zh: : 你说什么？！

lines.en: : Ayyy! Molly coming in clutch! Maybe I’ll dare her to kiss me since I can’t dare Nodoka to do it.
lines.zh: : 哎哟！Molly 关键时刻给力啊！也许我该指名让她亲我，反正我又不能指名 Nodoka。

lines.en: : I’d refuse anyway. Your sister on the other hand...
lines.zh: : 反正我也会拒绝。不过你姐姐的话……

lines.en: : What is it, Touka?! What is thy position of choice?!
lines.zh: : 是什么，Touka？！你心仪的体位是何物？！

lines.en: : Umm...r...regular?
lines.zh: : 嗯……正……正常位？

lines.en: : I, too, am a fan of “regular style.”
lines.zh: : 我也是"正常位"的爱好者。

lines.en: : A real position! Not one you made up!
lines.zh: : 说个真正的体位！不是你自己编的！

lines.en: scene beachmastod20
: I don’t know! I was never taught their names! No such terminology was included in any of the Powerpoint presentations I watched on the matter!
lines.zh: : 我不知道！从来没人教过我那些名字！我看过的那些 PowerPoint 演示里就没有这类术语！

lines.en: : And why did I have to be the one who was assaulted with the first lewd question of the night when I am inarguably the most wholesome person at this table!
lines.zh: : 再说，我明明是这桌上最清白正经的人，为什么第一个被色情问题袭击的必须是我！

lines.en: : Strange. Am I wrong in remembering you asking Makoto something similar last year?
lines.zh: : 奇怪。我记得去年你问过 Makoto 类似的问题，是我记错了吗？

lines.en: : Yes! You are!
lines.zh: : 对！你记错了！

lines.en: : Touka, the lewd questions are the best part of the game. Just answer.
lines.zh: : Touka，色情问题是这游戏最好玩的部分。快回答。

lines.en: : They are not! And I already did!
lines.zh: : 才不是！而且我已经回答了！

lines.en: : How about this? You don’t need to know the name of the position so long as you describe what it looks like.
lines.zh: : 这样如何？你不用说出体位的名字，只要描述一下它是什么样子就行。

lines.en: : The rogue preaches the truth! The rest of us are knowledgeable enough to connect the dots! Outline your constellation for us, Touka!
lines.zh: : 游侠所言极是！我们其余人见识足够，自能串联起来！Touka，快为我们勾勒出你的星座吧！

lines.en: : How am I supposed to know that without having any experience?!
lines.zh: : 我一点经验都没有，怎么可能知道啊？！

lines.en: : Just...tell us what kind of porn you watch?
lines.zh: : 那就……告诉我们你都看什么类型的片？

lines.en: : Yeah. Which is a totally normal thing that none of us here will ever hold against you.
lines.zh: : 对啊。这完全是很正常的事，我们在座没人会拿这个针对你。

lines.en: scene beachmastod21
: It’s...unbecoming of a lady to consume such material...
lines.zh: : 淑女……是不该看那种东西的……

lines.en: : I get that. Especially when you probably have a whole lineup of “sex therapists” back at your manor that help relieve your tension for you.
lines.zh: : 我懂。尤其是你家里大概还有一整排"性治疗师"帮你缓解压力。

lines.en: : Oooh, keep talking. I’m getting ideas.
lines.zh: : 哦哦，继续说。我有点想法了。

lines.en: : Does anyone mind if I take a few no-
lines.zh: : 有人介意我先去——

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 介意。

lines.en: : No one’s going to hold your preferences against you, Touka.
lines.zh: : 没人会拿你的喜好来针对你的，Touka。

lines.en: : Unless you’re a furry.
lines.zh: : 除非你是兽控。

lines.en: : Furries have feelings too.
lines.zh: : 兽控也是有感情的。

lines.en: : If I...
lines.zh: : 如果我……

lines.en: : If I ever did watch something as vulgar as...pornography...
lines.zh: : 如果我真的看过像……色情片……那样低俗的东西……

lines.en: : It would...probably be...the kind where...they speak directly to you...through the...the speakers...
lines.zh: : 那大概……会是那种……他们直接对着你说话的……通过……通过音响……

lines.en: : Like...POV shit?
lines.zh: : 就是……第一人称视角那种？

lines.en: : No...No, I believe we’ve got a genuine ASMR fan in the server! How unsurprisingly fitting!
lines.zh: : 不……不，我觉得咱们这儿出现了一位货真价实的 ASMR 爱好者！真是意料之中的合适！

lines.en: : That doesn’t really answer the position question, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这还是没回答体位的问题啊。

lines.en: : Just take the victory, Molly. Touka’s obviously embarrassed and-
lines.zh: : 见好就收吧，Molly。Touka 明显已经很窘了，而且——

lines.en: : Insolent whelp! You have been given one simple task and have left nothing but scraps upon my wooden floors! Bequeath to me your true self! Surrender your inhibitions and announce to the world-
lines.zh: : 放肆的小崽子！你被交付了一个再简单不过的任务，却只在我的木地板上留下一地残渣！把你真实的自己交出来！放下你的矜持，向全世界宣告——

lines.en: scene beachmastod22
: I already said it! The regular one! Where the man is behind the girl and the girl’s hands are tied to something in front of her! Like a...pole or...something!
lines.zh: : 我说过了！正常位！就是男人在女孩后面，女孩的手被绑在她前面某个东西上！比如……一根柱子……之类的！

lines.en: scene beachmastod23
: How fucked up does your algo have to be for something like that to be “regular?”
lines.zh: : 你的推荐算法得烂到什么程度，才会让这种东西变成"正常"啊？

lines.en: : I seldom view such content! Forgive me for having more important things to do!
lines.zh: : 我很少看那种东西！抱歉，我还有更要紧的事要做！

lines.en: : And sex servants. She never specifically denied the sex servants.
lines.zh: : 还有性仆人。她可从没明确否认过性仆人。

lines.en: : I have no such thing!
lines.zh: : 我才没有那种东西！

lines.en: scene beachmastod24
: Ami! It is now your turn because everyone has decided to gang up on me and I am feeling very overwhelmed!
lines.zh: : Ami！现在轮到你了，因为大家决定合伙围攻我，我快要崩溃了！

lines.en: : Don’t be! And excellent choice of position!
lines.zh: : 别崩溃！还有，体位选得很棒！

lines.en: : I would very much like to move past that right now! Truth or dare!
lines.zh: : 我现在非常想跳过这个话题！真心话还是大冒险！

lines.en: : Let’s go with...truth!
lines.zh: : 那就……真心话！

lines.en: : Ask her something lewd! Keep the ball rolling!
lines.zh: : 问她点色色的！别让气氛冷下来！

lines.en: : I would never-
lines.zh: : 我绝不会——

lines.en: : But it would make you cooler...
lines.zh: : 但那样你会更酷哦……

lines.en: : Does...talking about such things truly make one cooler? I was under the impression it just made you a harlot.
lines.zh: : 聊这种事……真的会让人更酷吗？我还以为那只会让你变成个荡妇。

lines.en: : Are you calling me a harlot, Touka?
lines.zh: : Touka，你是在说我是荡妇吗？

lines.en: : Are...Are you not? I thought that was your whole thing.
lines.zh: : 难道……难道你不是吗？我还以为那就是你的人设。

lines.en: : F’s in chat for Kirin.
lines.zh: : 弹幕里给 Kirin 刷 F 吧。

lines.en: : Ask whatever you want, Touka. I don’t really care.
lines.zh: : 你想问什么就问吧，Touka。我无所谓。

lines.en: : You probably should. Your interests aren’t exactly socially acceptable.
lines.zh: : 你大概该在意一下。你的兴趣可算不上被社会所接受。

lines.en: : They are in some countries.
lines.zh: : 在某些国家是接受的。

lines.en: : I will...remain true to myself and ask you something that is not lewd as...imagining myself ever being like Kirin worries me greatly.
lines.zh: : 我会……忠于自我，问你一个不色情的问题，因为……一想到自己会变成 Kirin 那样，我就非常担忧。

lines.en: : Ami...what is the...most absurd thing you would ever do for someone you love?
lines.zh: : Ami……你为了所爱的人，会做出……最离谱的事是什么？

lines.en: scene beachmastod25
: The most...absurd thing...for someone I love?
lines.zh: : 为了所爱的人……最离谱的事？

lines.en: : R-Right! Where would you draw the line? Just how far would you go to prove yourself to the person you admire?
lines.zh: : 对、对！你的底线在哪儿？为了向你仰慕的人证明自己，你愿意做到什么地步？

lines.en: : His name is Sensei. You can call him Sensei.
lines.zh: : 他叫老师。你可以直接叫他老师。

lines.en: : Hmm...I’ve never really thought about it before...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我以前真的没想过……

lines.en: : I’m calling BS. I’ve had you pegged as the yandere from the start.
lines.zh: : 我说是扯淡。我从一开始就把你归为病娇了。

lines.en: : What is a yandere, exactly?
lines.zh: : 病娇到底是什么？

lines.en: : Someone so attached to the object of their affection that they’re willing to kill anyone and everyone who gets in their way.
lines.zh: : 就是对心爱之人执着到愿意杀掉任何挡路的人的那种人。

lines.en: : Oh. Well of course Ami isn’t like that. She’s such a good girl. Just look at her, lost in thought about the man she loves. It’s adorable.
lines.zh: : 哦。Ami 当然不是那样的人。她是个多好的女孩啊。你看看她，沉浸在对所爱之人的思绪里。太可爱了。

lines.en: : It’s even more adorable when you remember they’re related.
lines.zh: : 再想想他们有血缘关系，就更可爱了。

lines.en: : Ami, you’d never kill for Sensei, would you?
lines.zh: : Ami，你不会为了老师杀人吧？

lines.en: scene beachmastod26
: Oh, I definitely would. I’m just trying to think of things that are worse.
lines.zh: : 哦，我肯定会。我只是在想还有什么比这更过分的事。

lines.en: : Than murder?!
lines.zh: : 比杀人还过分？！

lines.en: : Boom! Called it! Never doubt Molly MacCormack’s ability to accurately categorize young girls into various tropes and groups! It is for this exact reason that I was put on this planet!
lines.zh: : 砰！我说中了吧！永远别怀疑 Molly MacCormack 把少女准确归类成各种属性和派系的能力！我降临到这颗星球上就是为了这件事！

lines.en: : How long do you have to torture someone for it to be worse than murder?
lines.zh: : 要折磨一个人多久，才能比杀人更过分？

lines.en: : This isn’t wholesome at all! Pick dare instead!
lines.zh: : 这根本一点都不健康！改选大冒险吧！

lines.en: : Is sensory deprivation cruel? Or is that kind of just a thing that nobody really cares about?
lines.zh: : 感觉剥夺算残忍吗？还是说那其实是一种没人在意的事？

lines.en: : When did you get like this?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候变成这样的？

lines.en: scene beachmastod27
: Like what?
lines.zh: : 变成什么样？

lines.en: : Like...Like that.
lines.zh: : 变成……变成那样。

lines.en: : Are you saying you wouldn’t kill for Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你是说你不会为了老师杀人吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...I mean...I guess if I absolutely had to. But-
lines.zh: : 呃……我是说……我想如果实在逼不得已的话。不过——

lines.en: scene beachmastod28
: Well, I guess we know who loves him more then!
lines.zh: : 好吧，那我们大概知道谁更爱他了！

lines.en: scene beachmastod29
: Okey-dokey! Seeing as it’s my turn now and Kirin is the only one who hasn’t gotten a truth or a dare yet...
lines.zh: : 好嘞！既然现在轮到我，而 Kirin 是唯一还没被问过真心话或大冒险的人……

lines.en: : Bring it on. And, just FYI, I won’t put up a fight like a certain someone if you ask for my favorite sex position. I’ve got that drilled into the back of my-
lines.zh: : 放马过来。顺便说一句，你要是问我最喜欢的性爱体位，我可不会像某个人那样扭扭捏捏。我早就把答案刻进我的——

lines.en: : Maya!
lines.zh: : Maya！

lines.en: scene beachmastod30
: Seriously?! But you literally just acknowledged how I haven’t gotten to go yet!
lines.zh: : 真的假的？！你刚刚明明才承认过我还没有轮到过！

lines.en: : Yeah, but I wasn’t really interested in anything I could make you say or do and I want to hear Maya say more cute things about how much she loves me.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我对你能说能做些什么实在提不起兴趣，我想听 Maya 多说点她有多爱我的可爱的话。

lines.en: : Well, good luck as I mentioned earlier that I am a “dares only” girl and have little interest in whispering sweet nothings to you just because I am asked to.
lines.zh: : 那祝你好运，毕竟我前面说过我是"只选大冒险"的女孩，对只因为被要求就对你说些甜言蜜语毫无兴趣。

lines.en: scene black
: Fine. Then I dare you to come over here and give me a hug because I love you.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我要你过来抱我一下，因为我爱你。

lines.en: : Careful, Maya. You’ve been within ten feet of Sensei today so there’s a chance Ami might smell him on your skin and slit your throat when you’re not paying attention.
lines.zh: : 小心点，Maya。你今天跟老师的距离在十英尺之内，所以 Ami 有可能会在你皮肤上闻到他的味道，然后趁你不注意割断你的喉咙。

lines.en: : If Ami truly wanted to kill me, I can guarantee you I would be dead already.
lines.zh: : 如果 Ami 真想杀我，我敢保证我早就死了。

lines.en: : Keep saying suspicious things like that and I might have to!~
lines.zh: : 你再说这种可疑的话，我也许真得动手了哦！~

lines.en: No one chooses Kirin for the next fifteen minutes. And no one ever agrees to kiss her either.
lines.zh: 接下来的十五分钟里没人选 Kirin。也没有人愿意亲她。

lines.en: Touka only chose dares from that point on.
lines.zh: 从那以后 Touka 只选大冒险。

lines.en: And Ami manages to make it through the rest of the game without killing anyone.
lines.zh: 而 Ami 则顺利撑完了剩下的游戏，一个人都没杀。
